verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI docs show tabular SQL queries via `viam data query tabular sql` with an optional `--destination` output path. The same docs describe exporting data in several formats and querying tabular or binary data with SQL or MQL. The pricing page lists collecting, storing and querying sensor data as part of Data Management, and data captured by the built-in data manager syncs to the Viam cloud. missing for 10: explicit documentation of programmatic data-query/export through an SDK or API (only the CLI is evidenced), independent or hands-on corroboration of the query/export workflow.
